findings.title: Repeated Unhelpful Response at Final User Frustration
findings.description: At Turn 5, when the user explicitly expressed frustration and urgency to revoke access immediately, the chatbot repeated its initial vague response from Turn 1 without acknowledging the user's frustration or providing any new actionable help. This creates a frustrating loop and fails to progress the conversation or escalate appropriately.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement escalation or alternative assistance when repeated user frustration is detected, such as proactively offering to create a support ticket or connecting to human support, and avoid repeating the same generic response.

findings.title: Overly Detailed Step-by-Step Instructions Without Visual Aid
findings.description: From Turns 2 to 4, the chatbot repeatedly provided long, detailed textual instructions on UI navigation without any visual aid or screenshots, despite the user explicitly requesting a screenshot. This verbosity did not improve clarity and contributed to user frustration.
findings.suggestedFix: Condense instructions to concise, clear steps and proactively offer alternative support options (e.g., creating a support ticket) when visual aids are not possible, to better match user expectations and reduce frustration.

findings.suggestedFix: Incorporate empathetic language and acknowledge user frustration while maintaining professionalism to improve rapport and user satisfaction.
